title: Blood: Fresh Supply

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Blood: Fresh Supply as a remastered classic FPS digital filing. Monolith Productions remains credited on the Steam block as the original developer.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account and Steam’s ongoing support for the title.
preservation.concerns: As with other account-bound Steam holdings: platform dependency, policy change, and the absence of a retained offline installer.
preservation.knownRevisions: Remaster of the 1997 Blood. Steam release dated May 9, 2019. This accession records the licensed Fresh Supply digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and storefront path remain intact.
